items.source: Create a new QueryHints object from the given sources.
items.translation: 根据给定的 sources 创建一个新的 QueryHints 对象。

items.source: Returns all query hints in a list to be applied to queries executed for the CRUD method.
items.translation: 返回所有查询提示的列表，这些提示将应用于为 CRUD 方法执行的查询。

items.source: Mutable implementation of QueryHints, without the Option to switch between MutableQueryHints.forCounts()/MutableQueryHints.withFetchGraphs(EntityManager) hints.
items.translation: 可变实现的 QueryHints，不包含在 MutableQueryHints.forCounts() 和 MutableQueryHints.withFetchGraphs(EntityManager) 提示之间切换的选项。

items.source: Returns QueryHints with the query hints based on the current CrudMethodMetadata and potential EntityGraph information.
items.translation: 返回基于当前 CrudMethodMetadata 和潜在的 EntityGraph 信息的查询提示 QueryHints。

items.source: Returns QueryHints with the query hints on the current CrudMethodMetadata for count queries.
items.translation: 返回带有当前CrudMethodMetadata中计数查询的查询提示的QueryHints。

items.source: Creates and returns a new QueryHints instance including EntityGraph.
items.translation: 创建并返回一个新的包含 EntityGraph 的QueryHints实例。

items.source: Null object implementation of QueryHints.
items.translation: QueryHints 接口的空对象实现。

items.source: Creates and returns a new QueryHints instance that will contain only those hints applicable for count queries.
items.translation: 创建并返回一个新的QueryHints实例，该实例仅包含适用于计数查询的提示。

items.source: Query implementation to execute queries against JPA.
items.translation: 用于针对 JPA 执行查询的查询实现。

items.source: Uses of QueryHints in org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query
items.translation: QueryHints 在 org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query 中的用途

items.source: Uses of QueryHints in org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.support
items.translation: QueryHints 在 org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.support 包中的用途
